description: LotteryHub_0131.useCode(string,string) (AuditTarget.sol#56-61) calls abi.encodePacked() with multiple dynamic arguments: 	- id = keccak256(bytes)(abi.encodePacked(campaign,code)) (AuditTarget.sol#57)
LotteryHub_0131.beneficiary (AuditTarget.sol#16) is never initialized. It is used in: 	- LotteryHub_0131.moveToTreasury() (AuditTarget.sol#63-65)
LotteryHub_0131.quoteFee(uint256) (AuditTarget.sol#39-41) performs a multiplication on the result of a division: 	- amount / 10000 * rateBps (AuditTarget.sol#40)
LotteryHub_0131.zeroBalance() (AuditTarget.sol#67-69) uses a dangerous strict equality: 	- address(this).balance == 0 (AuditTarget.sol#68)
LotteryHub_0131.transferControl(address) (AuditTarget.sol#50-54) uses tx.origin for authorization: require(bool,string)(tx.origin == owner,not owner) (AuditTarget.sol#51)
